description: List the items in the brand's Webflow blog collection, most recently changed first: published, drafts and items with unpublished changes, each with its id, status, title and public address. Free. Webflow has no view counts on an item, so this carries none.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

title.description: only items whose title CONTAINS this text, ignoring case ("hermoso qa" finds "Hermoso QA test post")
